## Summary
- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate to audited main commit `0fbe6e7fced0fdabd4ba667fe7715dc20057e1e3` after PR #703
- retain the current blocked aggregate verdict: 6/13 required gates closed, 7 runtime/product gates still open, blocked, or insufficient
- add the after-703 evidence bundle with PR #698/#699/#700/#703 snapshots, merged PR metadata through PR #703, current workflow metadata, gate summaries, and checksums
- record PR #703 as Nubia P0110/pacific no-Host UI/UX current-main evidence only, not Host-backed product E2E evidence
- keep open non-owner PRs #701/#702 excluded from the merged PR guard for the audited 568-703 range

## Verification
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_macos_hardware_compatibility tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v` -> 135 tests OK
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests.phase3.test_repository_privacy.RepositoryPrivacyTests.test_current_tree_has_no_raw_android_serial_contexts -v` -> OK
- `make evidence-tools-test` -> exit 0
- `make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> exit 0; summary remains `aggregate_verdict=blocked`, `can_mark_phase0_stable_release=false`, source/owner PR/merged PR guards pass
- `make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=0fbe6e7fced0fdabd4ba667fe7715dc20057e1e3 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=.build/evidence/phase0-stable-release/after-703-local-summary.json` -> exit 0
- `make phase0-module-ownership-gate PHASE0_MODULE_OWNERSHIP_SUMMARY=.build/evidence/phase0-module-ownership/after-703-local-summary.json` -> exit 0
- `PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 ... make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> intentionally failed with make exit 2 and was retained as fail-closed evidence
- `shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-08-after-703-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS` -> all OK
- `git diff --check` and `git diff --cached --check` -> OK

## Remaining fail-closed risks
- `macos_host_hardware_compatibility_matrix`
- `telemetry_and_latency_archive`
- `host_rss_2h_no_growth`
- `native_pointer_hid_mouse`
- `controller_runtime_acceptance`
- `clipboard_android_macos_product_e2e`
- `file_transfer_android_product_e2e`

## Boundaries
- No Vibe Screen, MacHost, or Telemachus GUI was launched.
- No `swift run`, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, TCC, System Settings, or `adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321` operation was used.
- This PR does not mark Phase 0 stable, complete, shipped, or closed.
- Main ancestry was confirmed before the refresh: audited source is `0fbe6e7fced0fdabd4ba667fe7715dc20057e1e3`.
